preconditions.description: The number of commands n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(op in ['&', '|', '^'] and 0 <= x <= 1023 for op, x in commands)
preconditions.description: Each command consists of a valid bitwise operator ('&', '|', '^') and a constant x between 0 and 1023 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output program length k is between 0 and 5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1023 for op, x in output_commands)
postconditions.description: Each command in the output program uses a constant between 0 and 1023.

postconditions.expression: all(original_func(x) == output_func(x) for x in range(1024))
postconditions.description: For every input integer x from 0 to 1023, the output program produces the same result as the original program.
